title: mcp-google-search read_webpage server-side request forgery (CVE-2026-19337)
summary: @adenot/mcp-google-search (npm): the read_webpage MCP tool passes the caller-controlled url argument directly to axios.get in src/index.ts, validating only that it is a string, so a prompt-injected or malicious tool call can make the server request loopback, private-network, or cloud-metadata URLs from the server's network position (private-network SSRF). The upstream issue is open and no fixed release is published (npm latest is 0.3.1), so this is recorded as last_affected 0.3.1.
